## Problem

A clear description of the problem you're trying to solve or the limitation you're facing.

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you think this feature should work.

## Alternatives Considered

Other ways you've thought about solving this problem.

## Use Case

Who would benefit from this feature and how would they use it?

## Additional Context

Screenshots, mockups, or examples of similar features in other projects.

## Implementation Ideas

If you have thoughts on how this could be implemented, share them here.
